:::{#exr-half-space-practice}
#### Finding which open half-space holds a point

The sign of $\dprod{\vec{w}}{\vx} + b$ tells which [open half-space](#def-half-space)
of a [hyperplane](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-hyperplane) a point $\vx$ lies in.
Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the line in $\reals^2$ with $\vec{w} = (2, -1)$ and $b = -1$.

Decide whether $(0, 0)$ is in $\mathcal{H}^+$ or in $\mathcal{H}^-$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Evaluate $\dprod{\vec{w}}{\vx} + b$ at $(0, 0)$.
